title: Spaced-Review Resurfacing Queue
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=highlight:capture
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_reviewed)/86400,0)
| where days_since>review_interval_days
| sort - days_since
| head 20
description: Surfaces highlights due for review on a spaced schedule, turning saved passages into knowledge you keep.
value: Highlights you never revisit are wasted; a resurfacing queue is what turns reading into lasting learning.
implementation: Ingest highlights with review intervals into `index=personal`; surface those due for review.
visualization: Table of highlights due for spaced review.
grandmaExplanation: It resurfaces old highlights for you to review, so the best bits of your reading actually stick.
